$comment: Configuration defaults every SDK applies. Durations are in seconds here; the JS SDK takes milliseconds at its API surface and converts. Resolution order for a setting is always: the argument, then the environment variable, then the deprecated environment variable (with a warning naming its replacement), then the default below. The key rules mirror dsp-auth (keys are issued as sk_dsp_live_<secret>; it refuses the retired sk_dsp_test_ keys at exchange) and dsp-backend (it accepts the sk_dsp_ prefix, at most 200 characters, printable ASCII): a key that breaks them is refused locally, before any request, because the server would only answer a bare 401.
base_url_rule: https:// is required. Plain http:// is accepted only when the host is one of plain_http_hosts.
api_key_split: A key's prefix is its first three '_'-separated parts (sk, dsp, live): split with a bounded split("_", 3), since the secret may contain '_'.
retired_api_key: Test keys were retired on 2026-11-15 (dsp-auth #7): every key is a live key, charged from the workspace's credits. A key with the retired prefix is refused at construction with a message saying so, because the server would only answer a bare 401.
browsers: Not supported: dsp-backend refuses an API key on any request that carries an Origin header, which every browser sends. The JS SDK refuses to construct in a browser.

backoff.formula: uniform(0, min(cap_seconds, initial_seconds * 2^(n-1))) before attempt n
